Timeout middleware Wraps the downstream handler in a deadline. If the handler does not complete within the budget, a 504 Gateway Timeout is sent.

Cancellation is best-effort: Nim's cooperative futures cannot be force-cancelled, so on timeout the handler and any sub-futures it spawned keep running to completion in the background. Handler authors should use short-lived or internally cancellable sub-futures, or poll requestTimeoutRemainingMs to bail out early.

Middleware that answers with 504 Gateway Timeout if the handler does not complete within ms milliseconds.Returns a timeout middleware preconfigured for the named preset.Enforces a deadline: if next has not completed within ms milliseconds, a 504 Gateway Timeout is sent to the client.
